correctness.rationale: Route is PRESET_FALLBACK. Exact fallback_claim and fallback_qualification.exact_success_criterion were completed: independent rerun reproduced |G(6,3)|=4862 and |M(6,3)|=4862 and LGV total 4862. Legs 1-2: gen_gog(6) and gen_magog(6) each yield 7436 triangles (=ASM(6)); Schutzenberger S verified involutive on n=4 Gog and Magog sets; all 7436 S-images of Magog(6) satisfy GOGAm inequality (5.1); distinct left-3 projections (first k entries per row, matching Def 3.3/5.3) are 4862 on both sides; full left table replayed (n=4: 14/35/42; n=5: 42/219/387; n=6: 132/1594/4862). Code encodings match the paper: Gog = bottom row 1..n + strict rows + GT interlacing (Def 3.1); Magog = GT + Xjj<=j (Def 4.1); S = BK s_k operators composed as w1..w_{n-1} (Sec 2.3); is_gogam implements (5.1) over all chains. Leg 3: lgv_total(0,6,3)=4862 over 56 weakly-increasing bottom rows; LGV implementation independently validated against brute-force right-trapezoid counts at (3,2)=7,(4,2)=35,(4,3)=42,(5,2)=219,(5,3)=387, and right-Gog(6,3)=4862 brute-forced. Headline equality therefore holds by exhaustive enumeration (legs 1-2 alone suffice); LGV is a numerically agreeing third leg. DRAFT honestly labels the result computational, not an all-n bijection, and disclaims the Catalan-C9 coincidence. The n=7 (76505) mention is supporting only and outside the headline/verify scope.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: Biane-Cheballah 1401.6516 (verified in full text) introduces left Gog/GOGAm trapezoids, states Conj 7.2 equinumeration for all k, and proves explicit bijections only for (n,1) and (n,2) (Secs 9.1-9.2); Sec 10 gives only (n,3,3,3)-pentagon table. Fischer 1804.07054 (abstract verified) derives constant-term formulas for Gog trapezoids and LGV determinants for Magog sides explicitly as tools 'to eventually prove' the conjectures, not a 3-diagonal equality or count. Bettinelli 1512.03305 proves only the (n,2) right-trapezoid bijection. Fischer-Konvalinka 1912.01354 proves ASM-DPP (descending plane partitions), different objects from TSSCPP/Magog side, implying nothing about Gog-GOGAm. OEIS 'Gog trapezoid' returns no match. No prior source logs any 3-diagonal left-trapezoid count or (6,3) equality. Nuance considered: right-(6,3) Gog/Magog numbers are in principle computable from Zeilberger's proved right-trapezoid equinumeration plus the (3.1) left-right Gog involution, but no source logs N*=4862 as a left-trapezoid datum, and the equality with the left-GOGAm side is exactly the open Conjecture 7.2 cell, so the certified left equality is not mechanically implied. Internal priors differ: SCOPE-FAIL-20260908-004 (full monotone-triangle census) and SCOPE-FAIL-20260907-036 (length-4 pattern-pair Wilf-equivalence) are different claims/routes.
